This small piece of land I keep for sweet potato, just for my family to eat and maybe sell a little at the market. The fertilizer coupon I receive from FISP I always put on the maize garden, not here — sweet potato grows well enough without it if the rains come. I will use vines from my neighbor's last harvest like I always do, and I will put some manure from the chickens on the ridges before planting. I do the work myself with help from my daughter; we have no money to hire anyone for such a small plot.
